author: reek
body: Set testing: apply a permutation to the card pool and measure the effect by re-running the solver gauntlet. Two kinds of permutation: variation (change cards in place, e.g. buff a color's creatures -- ids are preserved so decks still reference them) and exclusion (drop a card and re-index so template ids stay list positions). The measurement is the gauntlet win distribution: a variation that helps a color shows up as more wins for that color's deck.

target: section:Exclusion -- Drop a Card and Re-index
author: reek
body: Removing a template shifts every later list position, and decks reference templates by position, so we filter then re-index (assign id = new position). Exclusion runs on the base pool before basics are appended.
